release_changes: Use the shared prepare/run/evaluate/report workflow; --workers defaults to 8 research tasks and the independent judge to 1.
Keep benchmark data, evidence readers, retrieval behavior, DSQA instruction and official judge prompts/protocol fixed.
Replace workstation-specific account, auth, broker and service-controller code with explicit standard Pi/Responses provider configuration.
Validate explicit context/output limits, bind evaluator inputs to the generation manifest, and keep interrupted or invalid judgments unknown on resume.
Normalize only serialized scalar gold-echo outer quotes; preserve original responses and the judge Boolean verdict.
Use actual displayed search IDs for recall; retain known usage separately from unknown compaction or failed-request amounts.
New portable runs account from Pi events. Frozen release records preserve the campaign transport accounting; costs with incomplete usage stay null.
Format newly released Python adapters and add offline boundary tests; existing BrowseComp-Plus and NeuCLIR settings/results are retained.
Expose the evaluated Anserini search/doc behavior through a portable loopback HTTP service with a pinned jar and corpus/indexing recipe.
Centralize retrieval limits and model budgets in configs/cmass.json, reject implicit model changes, and preflight retrieval before starting questions.
Verify the existing BCP tool descriptions, system/user prompts and both legacy configurations against a snapshot from the previous release.
reproduction_scope: Portable JevGPT configuration and offline verification of frozen results. Provider behavior and external index ranking are not claimed to be bit-identical across deployments.

record_selection.unit: One completed and independently scored output per fixed query.
record_selection.candidate_order: Use the latest completed, scored output represented by the frozen selection manifest; do not choose the maximum correctness value among candidates.
record_selection.attempt_field: Number of retained researcher trial paths per query at export; not extra accuracy observations.
